note: Fine-tuned MTP head (rev v4-islands): the v3 revision of the full-parameter distillation recipe, trained on an expanded mixed corpus (1.9M wikitext-103 prose + 850K Swift/Python source + 1.05M multi-turn chat + 0.5M math + 0.2M structured text) against the deployed 4-bit trunk's hidden-state distribution. On top of the quantized head this revision carries six BF16 precision-island tensors in the promoted island geometry (mtp.precision_islands.{q,k,v}.{weight,indices}): the full 1,024 K and V projection rows and the 1,024 Q rows with the largest 4-bit reconstruction SSE, restoring exact proposal-side arithmetic where quantization error concentrates. The candidate code path is the unmodified tip of main (island loader included); the trunk, verify kernels, emitted-token decision and rollback are unchanged. The head only proposes; every emitted token remains target-verified.
